events.title: Gore Grind is in Steam Next Fest - New Demo Out Now
events.summary: Gore Grind is taking part in Steam Next Fest, and we have a brand-new demo for it!The demo has been reworked since the last one, with a new tutorial, a reworked death and respawn flow, split-screen layout options for co-op, and a pile of fixes.Download the free demo from the store page, survive the night, and tell us what you think. If you enjoy it, a wishlist helps us a lot.See you on the streets.

events.title: Demo Update: Gore Grind Is Back, and It Brought Toys
events.summary: New toysFreeze things. Shatter things. Set things on fire, then freeze them again out of spite. Chuy's garage has been restocked with turrets and other hardware of uncertain origin. It fell off a truck.
